newsitem.title: USA: Quality Food to offer 4.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Quality Food to offer 4.5 mln shares.

text.p: Quality Food Centers Inc said Thursday it will offer 4.5 million common shares.
The company said additionally that it will begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange today under the symbol, "XQ."
It said the share offering will provide some of the financing in its proposed acquisition of Hughes Markets Inc and to refinance bank indebtedness.
The lead underwriters for the offering are Merrill Lynch & Co, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Salomon Brothers Inc. and Dain Bosworth Incorporated.
QFC is the second largest supermarket chain in the Seattle/Puget Sound region of the state of Washington.
